config.aoi_name: Lahore peri-urban expansion zone near Raiwind Road
config.aoi_description: South-western peri-urban belt of Lahore along the Raiwind Road corridor, south of Thokar Niaz Baig. The area mixes established housing, new housing schemes, roads, brick kilns and wheat/rice farmland, which makes it a typical example of Lahore's outward growth onto agricultural land.
